request.spec:
Invoices should move through stages. First a draft. Then I send it. Then it gets paid. Keep a
record when I send one. Only let me take payment once it has been sent.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Invoices should move through stages. First a draft. Then I send it. Then it gets paid. Keep a
record when I send one. Only let me take payment once it has been sent.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The change is complete and both acceptance tests pass. Here's what I implemented as a full-stack, additive change for the invoice lifecycle `DRAFT → SENT → PAID`:

**Database** (`src/main/resources/db/migration/V12__invoice_draft_default.sql`)
- New Flyway migration changing the `status` column default to `DRAFT` so new invoices start as drafts.

**Server** (OfficeFloor REST + Spring)
- `InvoiceService.send(id)` — guards that the invoice is a `DRAFT`, flips it to `SENT`, and records the audit line `INVOICE_SENT id=<id> amount=<n.nn>` via the `Audit` service.
- `InvoiceService.pay(id)` — now guards that payment is only allowed once an invoice is `SENT` (enforcing "only let me take payment once it has been sent" server-side too). Extracted a shared `find(...)` helper.
- `SendInvoiceLogic` + `rest/api/invoices/{invoiceId}/send.POST.yml` — a new one-file endpoint, mirroring the existing `pay` endpoint.
- `Invoice` entity default status changed to `DRAFT`.

**Front-end** (`ProjectDetail.tsx`)
- Added an `onSend` handler and a `Send` button (`invoice-send-<id>`) shown only for `DRAFT` invoices.
- The pay button (`invoice-pay-<id>`) now appears only for `SENT` invoices (previously any non-`PAID`), so a draft can't be paid until it's sent.

The existing `data-testid` anchors (`invoice-status`, `invoice-row-*`, `invoice-pay-*`) were preserved, and the test's expected audit record `INVOICE_SENT id=1 amount=100.00` matches exactly.
